exercises.sentence: If I ___ more time, I would travel more.
exercises.translation: Se eu tivesse mais tempo, viajaria mais.
exercises.explain: Segunda condicional: if + passado, would + verbo. Fala de situações hipotéticas no presente.

exercises.question: Qual frase fala de um arrependimento sobre o passado?
options: If I had studied, I would have passed.
If I study, I will pass.
If I studied, I would pass.
exercises.answer: If I had studied, I would have passed.
exercises.explain: Terceira condicional: if + had + particípio, would have + particípio.
Depois de “I wish”, recuamos um tempo verbal: can → could.

exercises.prompt: Se eu fosse você, eu aceitaria.
exercises.explain: Em “If I were you”, usa-se were para todas as pessoas no registro padrão.

exercises.prompt: Traduza: Se chover, ficaremos em casa
answer: if it rains we will stay home
if it rains we'll stay home
if it rains we will stay at home
if it rains we'll stay at home
exercises.explain: Primeira condicional: if + presente, will + verbo. Nunca use will depois de if.
